title: Ridgeway school solar bids
brief: Ridgeway School District has five bids for rooftop solar on its six schools, and the facilities director, Beatrice Ng, needs a comparison page for the board vote on 2026-11-17. Panels must be generating before the school year starts on 2027-09-01. Bids: SunHarvest, 1200 kW, price 2640000 dollars, 25-year savings 7400000, warranty 25 years, complete by 2027-08-15. Brightline Energy, 1150 kW, price 2415000, savings 7050000, warranty 20 years, complete by 2027-09-30. Copperfield Solar, 1250 kW, price 2875000, savings 7900000, warranty 25 years, complete by 2027-07-31. Halcyon Power, 1100 kW, price 2640000, savings 6800000, warranty 30 years, complete by 2027-10-31. Meridian Renewables, 1200 kW, price 2400000, savings 7150000, warranty 15 years, complete by 2027-08-31. Net 25-year benefit (savings minus price): 4760000, 4635000, 5025000, 4160000 and 4750000 in that order. Sections: "Bids", "Net benefit", "Schedule fit" and "Recommendation". Brightline and Halcyon would finish after the school year starts. Recommend Copperfield: the highest net benefit, 265000 dollars above SunHarvest, and the earliest completion; say plainly that it also has the highest upfront price, which the district must finance.

edit.request: Meridian Renewables lowered its price to 2300000. Update the price and its net benefit (4850000) everywhere.
